BAPUJEE COLLEGE
About
Bapujee College, Sarukshetri is a premier higher education institution in the eastern part of Barpeta District of Assam, India. The College was established in 1970 as a long-standing vision conceived by some of the eminent scholars and well-wishers of the locality with a commitment of achieving academic excellence and holistic development of the student community. The College is registered under Section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act 1956 in December, 1991. The college fraternity is committed to quality enhancement, continuous institutional improvement and has made persistent effort to uphold excellence in teaching, learning and governance. In the process the college has successfully completed the second cycle of NAAC accreditation in 2016. Previously, the college was affiliated under Gauhati University and at present, the college is under Bhattadev University, Bajali.

BAPUJEE COLLEGE
Principal's Desk
Dr. Khagen Das
Principal
Bapujee College, Sarukshetri
I feel myself proud and privileged when availing the opportunity of communicating through the website of the Bapujee College, Sarukshetri. The College was established in 1970 under the collective efforts and noble initiative of the people of Sarukshetri. Starting with only a handful of students, limited faculty and little property, the college has been able to complete its glorious journey of 55 years as a premier institution of higher education of the locality.
Education is the manifestation of love and it drives away ignorance. Education is not an act of acquiring knowledge but learning a skill to lead life and forming one’s personality. This is an ennobling process of growth. As an effective medium of social transformation, education energies a society and enables a man to earn his livelihood with due respect...
